Hi Laura — thanks for the clear ask and the questionnaire. We're happy to produce an operational pack. Quick answers up-front: 1) Hosted Redwood can be configured to process EU customer data exclusively (we use region-aware routing + in-region compute). 2) Backups and replica control are configurable; default hosted backups are region-local unless customer opts into cross-region replication. 3) Fallback behavior: automated routing to a secondary EU region with your configured policy; if you require strict no-fallback we can document an SLA and deployment path (Dedicated or Private).

I'll coordinate the detailed checklist with Legal and Infra. For transparency we'll tag items that need engineering diagrams (infra) vs legal attestation. Target: initial pack by next Thursday (2028-07-24). If that timeline doesn't work for you, say so and we'll accelerate.

Attachments: none

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Enterprise Sales — EMEA

Thanks — aim to have your drafts by EOD Tuesday (2028-07-23) so I can compile.

Hi Laura / Tom — quick update and delivery plan: 

1) We've completed the mapping table for the questionnaire. Marissa has drafted attestation language for items we can sign; the rest we will mark as "requires contractual amendment".
2) Aditya attached the infra diagram (redwood-infra-diagram.png) showing region-aware routing, in-region KV/cache locality, and backup flow (backups remain in-region by default; cross-region replication is opt-in).
3) Soojin confirmed BYOK support for customer-managed keys: key material never leaves the HSM in-region; key metadata stored in control-plane logs is pseudonymized — she's provided the log-retention window and audit trail steps.
4) Hannah outlined fallback options: (a) automatic failover to another EU region (default), (b) pinned Dedicated nodes with no automatic cross-region failover (for strict in-region-only policy). Option (b) requires Dedicated/Private.

I've uploaded the pack here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cRedwood-MedSys-SCCS (slide + checklist + infra diagram). We will also send a redlined attestation for signature.
